noticias.titular: Mets remove interim manager tag, hire Andy Green to 3-year deal
noticias.texto: The Mets have removed the interim tag from manager Andy Green, hiring him to a three-year deal through the 2029 season, it was announced Tuesday.

noticias.titular: Yankees don't expect Aaron Judge (calf) back for wild card
noticias.texto: Aaron Judge is not expected to be available for the Yankees' wild-card series as he continues to recover from a calf strain.

noticias.titular: Red Sox commit to Chad Tracy, Craig Breslow through 2030
noticias.texto: The Red Sox signed Chad Tracy to a three-year contract as manager while also exercising the 2029 and 2030 options on chief baseball officer Craig Breslow.

noticias.titular: Paul Skenes says WBC contributed to velocity drop in 2026
noticias.texto: Pirates ace Paul Skenes, whose season has been marked by an uncharacteristic dip in velocity, cited the World Baseball Classic as a source of his struggles this year.

noticias.titular: River Ryan, key piece in Tarik Skubal deal, leads Tigers
noticias.texto: River Ryan, acquired from the Dodgers in the Tarik Skubal trade, was outstanding in his Detroit debut Monday night, pitching three scoreless innings in a win against the Nationals.

noticias.titular: Sources: Cubs' Bregman suffered facial fractures from foul ball
noticias.texto: Chicago Cubs star Alex Bregman suffered multiple facial fractures after being struck by a foul ball while standing in the on-deck circle Sunday, sources told ESPN's Jeff Passan.
